_why: Positions for tests/desi-rules-played.mjs. They are created with service credentials rather than by the suite, because a seated player may not PATCH game_sessions — that is RLS working correctly and is itself covered by tests/undo.mjs and the leave suite. The suite RE-VERIFIES each position from the database before judging any rule against it, so a wrong id here fails loudly instead of quietly reporting a rule broken.
_lesson: The first version of these ids was mislabelled: they were mapped by a join on join_code that did not line up, so every tag pointed at the wrong board. Reading the positions back is what caught it. Never trust the label on a fixture.
_single_use: THESE ARE CONSUMED BY BEING LOOKED AT. LudoSession drives bot seats itself — it calls game_tick whenever the current seat is a bot, regardless of any clock — so merely opening one of these tables plays it on. A second run of this suite will find four boards advanced to near-finished and report the fixtures wrong, which is the guard working, not the rules breaking. Reset the five positions before each run.
